proposed_question.text: A storey has an occupant load of 750. Under the general Section 10.2.5.2 rule, how many means of egress are required unless a specific occupancy rule changes the answer?

rationale.correct: For occupant load more than 500 but not more than 1000, the means of egress must not be less than three.

distractors.A: The general rule does not allow one for this load.
distractors.B: Two is the baseline minimum, but 750 crosses the more-than-500 threshold.
distractors.D: Four is triggered for occupant load in excess of 1000.

rationale.takeaway: More than 500 up to 1000 requires at least three means of egress.
